mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( academy_id, login_id, password_hash, name, email, phone, role, status, created_at, kakaoId, school_grade ) VALUES ( #{academyId}, #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), #{kakaoId}, #{schoolGrade} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.academy_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.role, u.status, u.kakaoId, u.school_grade, c.name AS class_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN class_students cs ON u.user_id = cs.student_id AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id WHERE u.academy_id = #{academyId} AND u.role != 'ADMIN' ORDER BY u.user_id DESC
